validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" target="f"/></state><state id="f" type="final"/>
</scxml>

notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`: Attribute 'type' is not allowed for this element
diagnostics.help: SCXML has no state `type` attribute: a final state is written as the element `<final>`
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`)
